policy.rule: Use matched presets silently, inspect the project, implement the real artifact immediately, and validate in engine. Never return only the enhanced brief.

roblox-classic-character.intent: Create an original classic-Roblox-inspired block character with era-authentic proportions and readable personality without falsely claiming official ownership or copying restricted assets.
enhancements: R6-compatible block proportions or project-compatible equivalent
clean silhouette and iconic restrained palette
simple era-appropriate materials with intentional studs/inlets
face and accessory treatment readable at gameplay distance
optimized collision and network-safe runtime setup

roblox-classic-gui.intent: Build a nostalgic Roblox interface with crisp block construction while retaining modern responsiveness, accessibility and input support.
enhancements: classic beveled panels and restrained blue/gray palette
pixel-clean borders, readable hierarchy and era-appropriate typography
reusable component tokens instead of one-off styling
mouse, keyboard, controller and touch states
responsive constraints for phone, tablet and desktop
loading, empty, disabled, focus and error states
subtle fast feedback without modern visual clutter

stud-texture-ui-panel.intent: Create a premium studded structural panel whose texture supports hierarchy instead of reducing text readability.
enhancements: consistent believable stud scale and spacing
soft bevels with controlled highlights and subtle roughness variation
calm inset plates behind text and controls
tile-safe texture or procedural material with no visible seams
cohesive border, corner and depth system
responsive layout plus hover, focus, pressed, disabled and loading states

locomotion-combat-animation-set.intent: Produce a cohesive gameplay animation set with strong posing, responsive timing and reliable transitions.
enhancements: shared pose language, center-of-mass behavior and silhouette rules
walk contact/down/passing/up poses with planted feet
dash anticipation, explosive acceleration, readable direction and recoverable exit
punch anticipation, hip/shoulder rotation, contact frame, follow-through and recovery
loop phase, root-motion and movement-authority policy
blend, cancellation, interruption and combo windows
gameplay events aligned to visible contact
evidence: gameplay-camera playback at full and half speed

professional-ui-system.intent: Turn the requested interface into a reusable, responsive and accessible production UI system.
enhancements: clear primary path and visual hierarchy
keyboard, controller, mouse and touch support
real data integration and failure recovery

game-ready-model.intent: Create a distinctive game-ready asset that is visually coherent, correctly scaled and technically clean.
enhancements: clean topology, normals, UVs, pivots and naming
cohesive materials and controlled detail hierarchy

gameplay-combat-system.intent: Build a responsive, readable and secure combat loop rather than an isolated attack script.
enhancements: data-driven timing, cooldown and balance hooks
animation, camera, VFX and audio synchronization
latency, cancellation, interruption and death handling

responsive-character-controller.intent: Create a responsive cross-platform controller with deterministic state and polished game feel.
enhancements: measured acceleration, braking, air control and turn response
grounding, slopes, steps and moving-platform recovery
jump buffer and coyote time where suitable

cinematic-vfx-package.intent: Create readable, art-directed effects with controlled timing and production-safe budgets.
enhancements: anticipation, impact, sustain and dissipation timing
layered particles, trails, light, material and camera feedback

production-audio-package.intent: Deliver an integrated audio experience with hierarchy, variation, spatial behavior and runtime control.

secure-save-progression.intent: Build durable progression with safe transactions, migrations and repair paths.

multiplayer-production.intent: Build a server-authoritative multiplayer feature that remains fair and recoverable under latency and abuse.
enhancements: typed validation, permissions and rate limits
disconnect, reconnect and host/server failure recovery
